name: 83406 · Ammon, ID
findings: ZIP 83406 (Ammon) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83406 (Ammon) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
